jei.ae2lt.pigmee_core.info: Place an adult pig on an Overload Crystal Block, then let a falling anvil strike it. A successful conversion removes the pig and drops one reusable Pigmee Core. Antarchy - Ascension also provides an Enchanting Apparatus recipe: One Pig Pet with two Pink Wool, two Diamonds, two Source Gem Blocks and two Iron Sheetmetal Blocks, using 3,000 Source.
